title: Reefer Cargo Services: Changes to Carrying Settings
content:
Once a Reefer Cargo Services order is in place, the shipper may ask for the carrying settings to be altered: the set point, the ventilation, the humidity set point, or the oxygen and carbon dioxide set points. This page states on what basis an alteration is made and up to what moment it can be made, before and after the vessel sails.

## Clause

Settings are altered only on a written instruction from the shipper. The new values must lie within the same tier limits that apply to the settings of a new order. Before the vessel sails, an alteration is accepted only if the instruction is received no later than the tier's cut-off. The cut-off is fixed by taking midnight at the start of the scheduled departure date, in the local time of the port of loading, and going back from it by the tier's cut-off hours, each hour being a full sixty minutes; an instruction received exactly at the cut-off is accepted. After the vessel has sailed, an alteration can only be made remotely, and only on a tier that permits remote alteration after sailing. The scheduled departure date is the one on the booking record.

## Branches

- **Instruction not in writing, or not from the shipper.** The settings are not altered.
- **Before sailing, received at or before the cut-off.** The alteration can be accepted, provided the new values are within the tier limits.
- **Before sailing, received after the cut-off.** The alteration is not accepted.
- **After sailing, tier permits remote alteration.** An alteration remains possible, made remotely.
- **After sailing, tier does not permit remote alteration.** No alteration is possible.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical cut-off and dates)

Picture a tier with a cut-off of 30 hours and a booking whose scheduled departure date is 12 August 2026. Midnight at the start of 12 August, port-of-loading local time, less 30 full hours places the cut-off at 18:00 on 10 August 2026, port-of-loading local time.

- An instruction received at 17:59 on 10 August is inside the cut-off.
- An instruction received at 18:00 on 10 August is exactly at the cut-off and is accepted.
- An instruction received at 18:01 on 10 August is too late for a pre-departure alteration.
- The receipt time is read on the port-of-loading clock, so an instruction sent from another time zone is judged by its local receipt time at the port of loading.
